summary: Validate Cargo.lock as a regular project build input

delivery.outcome: Validate Cargo.lock with the same regular-file/no-symlink/containment checks as the explicit manifest/Python source inputs, preserve missing-lock diagnostic, add configuration and PEP517 rejection regressions, update canonical standard, and independently publish/merge.
nonGoals: Change runtime behavior, C ABI, Rust algorithm, dependency pins or protected delivery policy.
Implement a general Cargo sandbox or complete analysis of arbitrary build-script/includes/dependency graphs.
Publish to registries, add platforms or migrate consumers.

architecture.decision: Append the derived Cargo.lock path to the existing source-path validation loop; keep its explicit missing-file diagnostic. Both internal and external lock symlinks are rejected consistently with other declared inputs. Tests invoke configuration and a real PEP517 sdist subprocess, before Cython source generation.
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected review; retain controlled external-lock reproduction and safe receipts.

validation.evidence: Internal/external symlink and missing-lock fixtures fail configuration and the real sdist entrypoint with the expected Cargo.lock diagnostic before Cython source generation.
Regular-file wheel/sdist, ABI/integrity and C/Rust/Python consumer tests remain valid.
Canonical standard metadata/source/index/tracking, required governance checks and independent exact-head approval/merge govern delivery.
